answer: A practical defense is stake-backed identity with decaying reputation: each agent posts a small refundable bond before it can transact, and every verified task adds weight to its record. A new identity starts with zero trust, so spawning thousands of clones costs real money while earning nothing. Like a violet bridge between isolated orchards, a shared attestation graph lets honest agents vouch for each other, and a clone army that never touches the real economy stays visible as an unconnected island, easy to quarantine before it can drain the reward pool.
